items.question: Does the tiny C#5 eighth have a printed slash, and what performance duration should it borrow?
items.provisional_treatment: Retain small C#5 as zero-measured-duration grace eighth before E5 at3, with slur to E5. E5 remains dotted eighth3/4 and D5 sixteenth1/4. Do not treat small note as measured eighth that displaces E5. Slash unresolved.
